turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi Dr. Smith. Well, what brings me in is that I keep planning my days around not having to drive over those high bridges. I'll go out of my way to avoid them if I can. And if I really can't get around it and have to cross one, I just end up white-knuckling it the whole way across. I figured it was time to finally talk to someone about it.

symptom_reasoning.S064: The patient describes actively avoiding driving over high bridges by going out of their way, and enduring crossing them with extreme distress ('white-knuckling it').

turns.doctor_question: Aside from high bridges, do you notice similar anxiety in other situations, like being in open spaces, large crowds, or far from home?
turns.patient_response: No, not really. It's just the high bridges. I don't have any problem being in open spaces, and crowds don't bother me at all. I travel for work sometimes, so being far from home isn't an issue either. It's really just the bridges that get to me.
